item.text: {"search_note":"I did not find reliable 2023 evidence that Putin blocked or discouraged nuclear proliferation by Belarus or any other ally/client/proxy when doing so would have been politically useful. The available record points the other way: he accepted and publicized a forward nuclear deployment in Belarus.
